The scatter plot above is based on data collected from several homes in a given community. It shows the relationship between the age of a house and the number of people living in it. 

Given that none of the points overlap, which of the following statements are true?

- There is only one house where precisely $3$ people live.
- Two of the houses are $16$ years old.
- Only one house is older than $24$ years old.
worked_solution:
Let's examine our scatter plot.

- Statement I is true. The scatter plot has only one dot whose vertical coordinate equals $3,$ namely, $(18,3).$ This means that there is only one house where $3$ people live.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/7a56236f0c5649a64436809b2a5e1fb8f00ed3d345cd81c571f96d579d6c19b6.png)

 

- Statement II is false. The scatter plot has only one dot whose horizontal coordinate equals $16,$ namely, $(16,6).$ This means that only one house is $16$ years old.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/6d9a60cd10c6d7cc9f9d51d0be44c32cb688e19da988b3e84b30f0c4be32a2a8.png)

- Statement III is false. From the scatter plot, two houses are more than $24$ years old, represented by the two dots to the right of the vertical line.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/44b7395bb2e5ee0a71899869e6caedb949e8744adde314134f6a09e4c8f8a35d.png)

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only."
